title: Hamilton Moderne Large Leather Tote Bag
description_html:
Hamilton Moderne Large Leather Tote Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 20.5”W X 12”H X 5.5”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 10"
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Leather
  • Hardware: Silver-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Zip fastening
